differential.name: Diabetic kidney disease (diabetic nephropathy)
differential.rationale: A1c 7.7% with obesity and pre‑diabetes suggests early diabetes as the leading cause of CKD (GFR ≈ 60 mL/min).

differential.name: Hypertensive nephrosclerosis
differential.rationale: Age 55, obesity, and likely undiagnosed hypertension are common contributors to stage 3 CKD.

differential.name: Chronic analgesic/NSAID nephropathy
differential.rationale: History of recent fractures and likely use of pain meds can cause interstitial nephritis and reduced GFR.

differential.name: Obstructive uropathy (e.g., nephrolithiasis or chronic urinary retention)
differential.rationale: May present with slowly progressive creatinine rise; risk increased by obesity and possible dehydration from acute bronchitis.

differential.name: Primary glomerulonephritis (e.g., IgA nephropathy)
differential.rationale: Can cause modest proteinuria and CKD in middle‑aged adults; considered after more common causes are excluded.
